the development of a hypertensive response to angiogenesis inhibitors is an emerging issue.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BAY 43–9006 increases BP in a large percentage of patients and that these BP increases are likely to be related to an inhibition of the VEGF pathway.
BAY 43 9006 induced hypertension was not related to volume expansion and was associated with increased arterial stiffness and endothelial dysfunction.
BAY 43—9006-related hypertension is not a class effect of angiogenesis inhibitors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development of hypertension is a significant risk factor for patients receiving BAY43-9006 therapy.
the development of hypertension in patients receiving angiogenesis inhibitors is a real problem that should not be ignored.
